about.en: Velodrome Finance is a decentralized exchange and liquidity hub native to Optimism, designed around ve(3,3) tokenomics with vote-escrowed governance and liquidity gauges.
about.es: Velodrome Finance es un exchange descentralizado y centro de liquidez nativo de Optimism, disenado alrededor de tokenomics ve(3,3) con gobernanza vote-escrowed y gauges de liquidez.
about.ca: Velodrome Finance es un exchange descentralitzat i centre de liquiditat natiu d'Optimism, dissenyat al voltant de tokenomics ve(3,3) amb governanca vote-escrowed i gauges de liquiditat.
